scope: First Lyra art slice: nine authored clips. This does not cover all existing gameplay states or enable runtime replacement by itself.
timing_rule: Use the exact second values below. Fractional Blender keyframe positions are allowed; do not round .13s to an integer 60fps frame and move the hit window.

ownership.playback_and_blending: AnimationTree, driven from gameplay state and elapsed time
forbidden_clip_authority: decide attack completion solely from animation_finished

motion_extraction.root_translation_export: constant zero on locomotion/attack/dodge root; bake skeletal pose only
motion_extraction.root_rotation_export: constant rest orientation; world facing belongs to the controller
motion_extraction.virtual_locomotion: author contact/stride against source movement, then remove virtual translation; verify feet in world coordinates with actual physics movement
motion_extraction.ik: optional runtime foot/hand correction after rest/bone mapping; no IK implementation is implied

integration_prerequisites: ActorVisual.pose now accepts a read-only scalar presentation snapshot. Mount a validated rig explicitly through mount_rig; the current prototype remains the default until final art acceptance.

RunePlayer/RuneEnemy snapshots provide attack identity and actual CombatStrike elapsed/duration. Do not infer the active attack from the legacy normalized swing value. Startup/active/recovery are contracted by the effective attack data below.

Drive attack clip position from gameplay elapsed time or a synchronized physics clock, including .035s landed-hit pause and interruption. Rendering must not run the clip ahead while physics is paused.
Current default movement named walk is 6.4m/s combat locomotion, closer to a fast jog. A normal slow walk clip retimed blindly will visibly slide or look rushed.

Light_1, light_2 and light_3 all use the same signed horizontal arc sweep in current code. Do not author a reversed second active cut or purely vertical third active cut and claim it matches the current predicate.
Stop the active visual state on parry/stagger/death/restore and discard pending visual events. A canceled clip cannot emit delayed strike VFX.
A full runtime swap needs coverage for heavy/charged-heavy/three skills/death/heal and lock-on strafing as well. These are explicitly outside the nine-clip slice, not silently complete.

clips.name: idle
clips.purpose: Balanced ready stance, sword in the right hand, subtle breathing; no hip/feet drift.
clips.loop_acceptance: same first/last root and planted-foot transforms; no perceptible seam at real-time playback

clips.name: walk
clips.purpose: Default 6.4m/s combat jog, not a slow pedestrian walk.
clips.playback_rule: scale by measured horizontal speed / 6.4 within reviewed limits, blend to idle near zero, separately review locked-target lateral/backward movement

clips.name: run
clips.purpose: Committed 8.5m/s sprint, controlled torso and weapon, no large cape obscuring combat.
clips.playback_rule: match measured velocity, not only sprint-button state; do not keep sprinting feet after collision stops movement

clips.name: dodge
clips.purpose: Compact directional evasive burst with clear start and planted recovery; no mandatory full roll.
clips.direction_rule: code may dodge forward, backward or sideways independent of facing; the first forward candidate must not imply all directional clips are finished

clips.name: light_1
clips.purpose: Fast right-to-left opening cut, readable torso windup and recovering guard.

contacts.rule: author a virtual lunge/step and verify world-space planting under code-driven motion; code can shorten movement on walls

clips.hit_rule: impact VFX/audio only on actual landed_hit/on_hit, not an unconditional animation contact event
clips.transition_rule: follow code cancel at active_end when buffered; stop immediately on hit/parry/dodge/death/restore, with at most a short reviewed visual-only inertial blend

clips.name: light_2
clips.purpose: Second cut with a fast re-chamber and the same signed active sweep as current code.

contacts.rule: author a virtual lunge/step and verify world-space planting under code-driven motion; code can shorten movement on walls

clips.hit_rule: impact VFX/audio only on actual landed_hit/on_hit, not an unconditional animation contact event
clips.transition_rule: follow code cancel at active_end when buffered; stop immediately on hit/parry/dodge/death/restore, with at most a short reviewed visual-only inertial blend

clips.name: light_3
clips.purpose: Heavier descending-diagonal finisher whose horizontal progression still matches the signed code arc.

contacts.rule: author a virtual lunge/step and verify world-space planting under code-driven motion; code can shorten movement on walls

clips.hit_rule: impact VFX/audio only on actual landed_hit/on_hit, not an unconditional animation contact event
clips.transition_rule: follow code cancel at active_end when buffered; stop immediately on hit/parry/dodge/death/restore, with at most a short reviewed visual-only inertial blend

clips.name: parry
clips.purpose: Quick guard into a readable narrow intercept pose with controlled weapon grip.

contacts.both_feet: stable planted guard; code reduces requested movement to .1 during parry

clips.success_rule: parry_time is cleared immediately on success; success flash and follow-up pose are driven by parried signal, not by a scheduled clip event
clips.failure_rule: at window end recover with blend; do not extend gameplay parry or hold until cooldown ends

clips.name: hit
clips.purpose: Short torso recoil with the feet kept grounded and stable silhouette.

contacts.both_feet: use a short additive torso recoil or an authored balanced recovery; avoid moving root

clips.recovery_rule: allow controller locomotion again at stagger end; .7s invulnerability is not a .7s locked hit animation
clips.integration_note: current pose API has no hit argument; requires explicit presentation state, not just this clip file

heavy.note: charged heavy changes power, not these timings; must supply reviewed clip mapping before a full runtime replacement

death_heal_lockon_strafes.note: explicit animation/pose mapping and runtime acceptance required; no silent idle fallback during an attack or death
